title: Data and Statistics Basics
objectives: Read and interpret various types of graphs and charts
Calculate measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode)

introduction.context: Every day we see statistics: weather forecasts, sports scores, election polls, and social media analytics. Understanding data helps us make informed decisions!
introduction.connection: Data analysis skills are essential for interpreting news, making business decisions, understanding scientific research, and even managing personal finances.

concepts.title: Mean, Median, Mode
concepts.content: Mean is the average (sum divided by count). Median is the middle value when data is ordered. Mode is the most frequent value. These measures help us understand the center of data.

concepts.title: Probability
concepts.content: The likelihood that an event will occur, expressed as a fraction, decimal, or percentage. Probability ranges from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain).

commonErrors: Forgetting to divide by the count

practice.explanation: The mode is 5 because it appears 3 times, more than any other value.
hints: Look for the most frequent value
